CREATE TYPE efficiency_classification AS ENUM ('Excellent Efficiency', 'Good Efficiency', 'Average Efficiency', 'Poor Efficiency');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classify_battery_efficiency()
RETURNS TABLE(
    device_id character varying,
    efficiency_value numeric,
    classification efficiency_classification
) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        di.devregistry AS device_id,
        ROUND(CAST((ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (di.pwractmw * 10) AS numeric), 2) AS efficiency_value,
        CASE
            WHEN (ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (di.pwractmw * 10) > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'::efficiency_classification
            WHEN (ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (di.pwractmw * 10) >= 5.0 THEN 'Good Efficiency'::efficiency_classification
            WHEN (ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (di.pwractmw * 10) >= 2.5 THEN 'Average Efficiency'::efficiency_classification
            ELSE 'Poor Efficiency'::efficiency_classification
        END AS classification
    FROM
        deviceidentity di
    JOIN
        testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
    WHERE
        di.conntype LIKE '%Wireless%' OR di.conntype = 'Bluetooth';
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
